promises.title: One app for your whole trip

items.title: Fly for less
items.text: Set a price alert on your route. As soon as a flight drops below your budget, Yadony lets you know.

items.title: Sell your kilos
items.text: Suitcase not full? Post your trip, set your price and carry parcels for verified senders.

items.title: Send with peace of mind
items.text: Your parcel travels with a verified person. The money is held until delivery, and you follow every step live.

crossed.title: Awa is flying to Dakar. Moussa is sending a parcel to his mother.
crossed.lead: Follow them step by step: their paths cross in Yadony.
crossed.listLabel: Awa and Moussa's journey, in eight steps

steps.title: The alert goes off: the flight is cheaper
steps.text: Awa set a price alert on Paris – Dakar. A flight drops below her budget: Yadony lets her know, and she books with our partner.

steps.title: Awa posts her trip
steps.text: Date, kilos available, handover points. She picks her pricing: a price per kilo, a price open to offers, or a price list per item.

steps.title: Moussa looks for a traveller
steps.text: On the map or in the list, he sees the verified travellers heading to Dakar. He can also post a shipping request and let travellers make him an offer.

steps.title: They negotiate in the app
steps.text: Moussa suggests a price, Awa makes a counter-offer, and they reach a deal. Everything stays in writing in the app, with no need to swap numbers.

steps.title: The payment is held
steps.text: Moussa pays by card, mobile money or wallet. The money does not go to Awa: it waits for delivery.

steps.title: The handover, scanned and photographed
steps.text: Moussa hands over the parcel in person. Awa scans its QR code: the photo and time are recorded, even without signal.

steps.title: The parcel travels, the family follows
steps.text: Handed over, in the air, arrived: every step shows up live. Moussa's mother follows it all on a web page, without installing the app.

steps.title: Delivered against a code, Awa gets paid
steps.text: In Dakar, Moussa's mother gives her 6-digit code. Delivery is confirmed and the money is paid out to Awa.

trust.title: What WhatsApp groups were missing
trust.lead: The traveller was already there. Yadony adds the record: who is carrying it, when, and proof at every step.

items.title: Verified identity
items.text: ID document and selfie checked before anything is posted. The name you see is the verified name.

items.title: Payment held
items.text: The money waits for delivery. If there is a dispute, it stays on hold while the case is reviewed.

items.title: Proof at every step
items.text: QR code scan, time-stamped and geotagged photo, at handover and in transit.

items.title: Delivery code
items.text: The parcel is only handed over against the 6-digit code that only your recipient knows.

trust.donyAlt: Dony, the Yadony mascot, all smiles

payments.title: Pay the way you do at home
payments.lead: Bank card in Europe and North America, mobile money in West and Central Africa, the Yadony wallet everywhere.
payments.note: Cash is still an option, but without the held payment: the protection only applies to payments made in the app.
